Title: Organic Turmeric Powder (Haldi)
Body (HTML):
Bring the golden touch of ancient Ayurveda to your kitchen with Dalify's Organic Turmeric Powder. Sourced from certified organic farms in Erode — India's turmeric capital — our haldi is sun-dried and stone-ground to preserve its natural curcumin content and vivid golden hue.

Unlike commercial turmeric blended with starches and artificial colorants, every batch from Dalify is 100% pure root, nothing else. Use it in your daily dal tadka, golden milk latte, or a simple haldi-doodh before bed.

Suggested use: Curries, soups, golden milk, marinades, rice dishes.

Title: Organic Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
Body (HTML):
The aroma of cumin hitting hot oil is the smell of Indian home cooking at its finest. Dalify's Organic Cumin Seeds are hand-picked from small farms in Rajasthan, where the dry climate produces seeds with a deeper, more complex flavor profile than mass-market varieties.

Each seed is cleaned and packed without any fumigants or chemical treatments. Rich in iron and known to support digestion, jeera is one of the most versatile spices in your pantry.

Suggested use: Tadka, dal, biryani, raita, chaat, chaas.

Title: Organic Cumin Powder (Jeera Powder)
Body (HTML):
Pre-ground from premium Rajasthani organic cumin seeds, our Cumin Powder delivers instant depth to any dish. Stone-ground fresh in small batches to lock in the volatile oils responsible for that signature earthy warmth.

Absolutely no fillers, no anti-caking agents — just pure roasted cumin aroma in every spoonful.

Suggested use: Curries, sabzis, raita, chutneys, marinades, spice blends.

Title: Organic Coriander Powder (Dhaniya Powder)
Body (HTML):
Ground from whole, sun-dried organic coriander seeds, Dalify's Dhaniya Powder carries a warm citrusy note that rounds out virtually every Indian curry. Our coriander is sourced from farms in Madhya Pradesh, where the soil and climate yield seeds with a naturally higher essential oil content.

Ground in small batches and sealed in airtight pouches to preserve freshness.

Suggested use: Curries, chutneys, marinades, masala blends, gravies.

Title: Organic Red Chili Powder (Lal Mirch)
Body (HTML):
Not all chili powders are equal. Dalify's Organic Red Chili Powder is made exclusively from Kashmiri and Byadagi chili varieties — prized for their deep red color and medium heat that adds vibrancy without overwhelming the palate.

No artificial colors (no Sudan Red), no added salt, no fillers. Just sun-dried organic chilies, ground to a fine powder.

Suggested use: Curries, marinades, dry rubs, chutneys, aloo sabzis.

Title: Organic Garam Masala
Body (HTML):
Our Garam Masala is an homage to the spice blenders of old Delhi. A carefully balanced blend of organic cardamom, cloves, black pepper, cinnamon, cumin, coriander, and nutmeg — all sourced individually from their regions of provenance and blended in our facility.

No shortcuts, no fillers, no MSG. Add a pinch at the end of cooking to preserve the fragrant top notes.

Suggested use: Dal, biryani, curries, kebabs, pulao, finishing spice.

Title: Organic Mustard Seeds (Rai)
Body (HTML):
Tiny but mighty — mustard seeds are the starting gun for most South Indian cooking. Dalify's Organic Mustard Seeds are sourced from Rajasthan's certified farms and are free from any pesticide residue.

Temper them in hot oil until they pop and release their nutty, pungent flavor, then build your dish from there.

Suggested use: Tadka, South Indian curries, pickles, chutneys, rice dishes.

Title: Organic Fenugreek Seeds (Methi Dana)
Body (HTML):
Fenugreek seeds carry a slight bitterness that — when used right — adds incredible complexity to Indian cooking. Dalify's Organic Methi Dana comes from Rajasthan farms with no chemical treatment.

Use sparingly in tadkas for sambar and dal, or soak overnight and sprout for a nutritious addition to your morning routine.

Suggested use: Tadka, pickles, sprouting, sambar, fenugreek bread.

Title: Organic Green Cardamom (Elaichi)
Body (HTML):
Dalify's Organic Green Cardamom pods are sourced from the lush cardamom hills of Idukki, Kerala — the world's finest cardamom growing region. Each pod is hand-picked at peak maturity, ensuring maximum essential oil content and that unmistakable floral-citrus aroma.

Use whole pods in chai, biryani, and kheer, or crack them open and grind the seeds for baking and desserts.

Suggested use: Chai, biryani, kheer, desserts, lassi, flavored rice.

Title: Organic Cloves (Laung)
Body (HTML):
Hand-sorted whole cloves from Kerala's certified organic spice gardens. Our cloves have an intense eugenol content that gives them their characteristic warm, sweet-pungent flavor.

Essential in biryani, meat curries, and masala chai. Also widely used in home remedies for toothaches and digestive issues.

Suggested use: Biryani, curries, chai, spice blends, pickling.

Title: Organic Black Pepper Whole (Kali Mirch)
Body (HTML):
Tellicherry black pepper — the gold standard of Indian pepper — from certified organic farms in Wayanad, Kerala. Larger berries, higher piperine content, more complex flavor than regular black pepper.

Our pepper is unbleached, fully ripened before harvest, and immediately sun-dried to lock in flavor. Grind fresh over your food or crack coarsely into marinades.

Suggested use: Marinades, grills, soups, rasam, chai, all-purpose seasoning.

Title: Organic Kashmiri Red Chili (Whole)
Body (HTML):
For color without the burn. Kashmiri chilies are famous for imparting a gorgeous deep-red hue to dishes while keeping the heat mild and approachable. Dalify sources these from certified organic farms in Jammu & Kashmir.

The go-to chili for rogan josh, butter chicken, and kebab marinades.

Suggested use: Rogan josh, butter chicken, kebab marinades, soups.

Title: Organic Cinnamon Sticks (Dalchini)
Body (HTML):
True Ceylon cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum), not the commonly sold cassia bark. Dalify sources authentic Ceylon cinnamon from Sri Lanka for a sweeter, more delicate flavor with lower coumarin content — safer for daily use.

Perfect for infusing into curries, biryanis, and chai.

Suggested use: Biryani, curries, chai, desserts, flavored rice.

Title: Organic Bay Leaves (Tej Patta)
Body (HTML):
Indian bay leaves (tej patta) have a distinct clove-cinnamon flavor profile quite different from Mediterranean laurel. Dalify's tej patta comes from organic farms in Uttarakhand.

Add whole leaves to hot oil at the start of cooking to infuse the oil with a subtle spice complexity.

Suggested use: Biryani, pulao, curries, potato dishes, soups.

Title: Organic Asafoetida (Hing) — Compound
Body (HTML):
A small pinch of hing transforms a humble dal into something memorable. Our compound asafoetida is made with a higher resin content than typical commercial varieties, giving you the pungent, savory depth associated with authentic Mughlai and Rajasthani cooking.

Just a tiny pinch (⅛ tsp) in hot ghee is all you need for a full pot of dal.

Suggested use: Dal tadka, vegetable curries, pickles, digestive spice.

Title: Organic Dry Mango Powder (Amchur)
Body (HTML):
Tart, tangy, and totally irreplaceable — amchur is what gives chaat its signature punch. Dalify's Organic Dry Mango Powder is made from unripe Alphonso mangoes sun-dried and ground without any additives.

Add it to aloo tikki, pav bhaji, or dal for a burst of sourness that cuts through richness beautifully.

Suggested use: Chaat, aloo tikki, dal, vegetable stir-fries, marinades.

Title: Organic Chaat Masala
Body (HTML):
The soul of Indian street food. Our Chaat Masala is a hand-blended mix of organic amchur, black salt, roasted cumin, coriander, black pepper, dried ginger, and chili.

No artificial flavors, no synthetic ammonium chloride substitute. Sprinkle on fruit chaat, aloo tikki, pani puri water, or simply on sliced cucumber and tomatoes.

Suggested use: Fruit chaat, aloo tikki, pani puri, pav bhaji, chaas, salads.

Title: Organic Chole Masala
Body (HTML):
A specially crafted spice blend designed for the perfect Punjabi chole. Our Chole Masala features organic pomegranate seed powder (anardana), amchur, black cardamom, and a precise balance of whole spice powders.

No artificial colors (no caramel color). Add it mid-cooking and let the spices bloom into the onion-tomato base for authentic dhaba-style flavor.

Suggested use: Chole bhature, chana masala, chana pulao.

Title: Organic Pav Bhaji Masala
Body (HTML):
Capture the essence of Mumbai's most beloved street food at home. Dalify's Pav Bhaji Masala is a balanced blend of organic coriander, cumin, chili, dry mango powder, and black salt.

No MSG, no synthetic color — just the real deal. The right blend makes the difference between an okay bhaji and one that has the whole family scraping the pan.

Suggested use: Pav bhaji, tawa pulao, masala pav.

Title: Organic Sambar Powder
Body (HTML):
Authentic South Indian sambar starts with the right powder. Our recipe draws on traditional Tamil and Karnataka blends — featuring organic chana dal, urad dal, coriander, cumin, dried red chilies, and curry leaves, all dry-roasted and ground together.

The result is a complex, layered powder. Works equally well in rasam and vegetable kootu.

Suggested use: Sambar, rasam, vegetable kootu, rice dishes.

Title: Organic Rasam Powder
Body (HTML):
A lighter, more peppery blend than sambar powder, specifically tuned for the bright, thin broth of traditional rasam. Our Rasam Powder uses organic black pepper, long pepper, coriander, cumin, and dried curry leaves.

Make a quick tomato rasam in under 15 minutes, or add a spoonful to hot water and sip it as a comforting digestive tonic.

Suggested use: Tomato rasam, pepper rasam, as a digestive drink.

Title: Organic Kitchen King Masala
Body (HTML):
An all-purpose North Indian masala that does exactly what its name promises — it rules the kitchen. Our Kitchen King is a versatile blend suited for everything from paneer butter masala to mixed vegetable curry. Made from 15+ organic spice ingredients with no fillers, no artificial flavor enhancers.

Suggested use: Paneer dishes, mixed veg curries, dal, stuffed parathas.
Tags: organic,kitchen king,all purpose masala,north indian,spice blend

Title: Organic Biryani Masala
Body (HTML):
Biryani deserves a masala as special as the dish itself. Our Biryani Masala is a whole-spice blend featuring organic star anise, mace, nutmeg, black cardamom, green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, and bay leaves.

Each jar is freshly blended in small batches. No shortcuts. No rice flour fillers.

Suggested use: Chicken biryani, lamb biryani, veg biryani, pulao.

Title: Organic Dried Fenugreek Leaves (Kasuri Methi)
Body (HTML):
The finishing touch that elevates butter chicken, paneer tikka masala, and countless other North Indian dishes. Kasuri Methi carries a slight bitterness and an intoxicating aroma when crushed between your palms before adding.

Dalify's organic dried methi leaves contain no artificial green coloring (a common adulteration in cheaper brands).

Suggested use: Butter chicken, paneer dishes, parathas, aloo dishes, dal.

Title: Organic Aged Premium Basmati Rice
Body (HTML):
Nothing compares to properly aged basmati. Dalify's Premium Aged Basmati comes from the foothills of the Himalayas — Dehradun and Karnal — and is aged for a minimum of 12 months to develop the signature long, non-sticky grain and that unmistakable fragrance.

Certified organic, parboiling-free, and free from synthetic aging agents. Cook at 1:1.5 (rice:water) for perfect separate grains every time.

Suggested use: Biryani, pulao, steamed rice, khichdi, fried rice.

Title: Organic Sona Masoori Rice
Body (HTML):
The everyday rice of South India — loved for its light texture, medium grain, and gentle starch that makes it ideal for everyday meals without weighing you down. Dalify's Sona Masoori is sourced directly from farms in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, certified organic.

Lower glycemic index than standard white rice. Cooks beautifully in a pressure cooker or rice cooker.

Suggested use: Steamed rice, curd rice, lemon rice, pongal, rice porridge.

Title: Organic Red Rice (Kerala Matta)
Body (HTML):
Rich in anthocyanins and iron, red rice has been a staple of Kerala households for generations. Dalify sources Matta (Rosematta) red parboiled rice from certified farms in Palakkad, Kerala.

Its slightly nutty, earthy flavor pairs beautifully with Kerala curries. The bran layer is retained, making it a whole grain option that supports sustained energy.

Suggested use: Steamed rice with Kerala curries, rice porridge, rice cakes.

Title: Organic Brown Basmati Rice
Body (HTML):
All the fragrance of premium basmati with the added nutrition of the bran layer. Our Brown Basmati is organically grown in the Himalayan foothill region, minimally processed to retain the bran and germ.

Higher in fiber, B vitamins, and magnesium than white rice. A smarter choice for everyday cooking that doesn't sacrifice aromatic quality.

Suggested use: Pulao, biryani, everyday rice, grain bowls.

Title: Organic Foxtail Millet (Kangni)
Body (HTML):
Ancient grains are having a well-deserved renaissance, and foxtail millet leads the pack. Rich in complex carbohydrates, protein, and iron, kangni has been cultivated in India for over 7,000 years. Dalify sources this from dryland organic farms in Andhra Pradesh.

Cook it like rice (1:2 ratio) for a nutty, satisfying grain. Naturally gluten-free.

Suggested use: Cooked like rice, upma, khichdi, rotis, porridge.

Title: Organic Pearl Millet (Bajra)
Body (HTML):
The grain of Rajasthan's desert warriors. Bajra is one of the most nutritious millets — high in protein, iron, and phosphorus, and exceptionally heat-tolerant. Dalify's bajra comes from Rajasthan and Gujarat organic farms.

Make bajra roti, add to soups, or use bajra flour for porridge in winter. Naturally gluten-free and incredibly filling.

Suggested use: Bajra roti, khichdi, porridge, flour for flatbreads.

Title: Organic Finger Millet (Ragi / Nachni)
Body (HTML):
Ragi is one of the most calcium-rich grains on earth — making it invaluable for vegetarian diets. Our certified organic finger millet from Karnataka is milled to a fine flour that's perfect for ragi mudde, ragi dosa, or ragi porridge for toddlers and seniors alike.

Deep earthy flavor and a naturally dark brown color. Gluten-free.

Suggested use: Ragi mudde, ragi dosa, ragi porridge, rotis, malt drinks.

Title: Organic Little Millet (Samai)
Body (HTML):
One of the smallest and most nutritious of the millet family. Little millet is light on the stomach, high in fiber, and perfect as a rice substitute for those managing blood sugar.

Cook it as plain rice, use it in pongal or khichdi, or grind into flour for pancakes and rotis. Dalify's organic samai comes from Karnataka.

Suggested use: Plain cooked grain, pongal, khichdi, rotis, porridge.

Title: Organic Kodo Millet (Varagu)
Body (HTML):
Known as the 'poor man's superfood' in Tamil Nadu, kodo millet is experiencing a revival as a diabetes-friendly grain. It cooks to a soft, slightly sticky consistency — ideal for traditional South Indian preparations and as a rice substitute in everyday cooking.

Dalify sources certified organic varagu from Tamil Nadu farms.

Suggested use: Cooked rice substitute, pongal, idli, dosa batter.

Title: Organic Sorghum (Jowar)
Body (HTML):
The grain that powered generations of Marathas. Jowar is high in protein and iron, and makes some of the most satisfying rotis in Indian cuisine.

Dalify's organic jowar comes from Maharashtra and Karnataka. Use jowar flour for bhakri or mix with wheat flour for everyday rotis with extra nutrition. Also excellent puffed as a snack grain. Gluten-free.

Suggested use: Jowar roti, mixed-grain flour, puffed snacks, porridge.

Title: Organic Amaranth (Rajgira)
Body (HTML):
Amaranth is unusually high in protein (including lysine — an amino acid rare in grains) and calcium. Dalify sources organic rajgira from Maharashtra.

Use it in porridge, laddoos (rajgira laddoo are a Navratri staple), or pop the tiny seeds in a dry pan for a crunchy topping. Naturally gluten-free.

Suggested use: Rajgira laddoo, porridge, flour for rotis, popped grain snack.

Title: Organic Khapli Wheat Berries (Emmer)
Body (HTML):
Move over, processed atta. Dalify offers whole khapli (emmer) wheat berries — an ancient variety of wheat with a lower gluten content and higher fiber, protein, and mineral profile than modern wheat. Sourced from organic farms in Maharashtra.

Mill at home or soak and cook whole for a hearty grain bowl.

Suggested use: Homemade stone-mill flour, grain bowls, wheat porridge.

Title: Organic Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta)
Body (HTML):
Stone-milled from premium whole wheat berries, our chakki atta retains the germ and bran that commercial refiners discard. The result is a flour with a warm, nutty flavor, higher fiber content, and a natural golden-brown color.

Certified organic, no bleaching agents. Makes rotis with a slightly more rustic texture that holds up beautifully to thick gravies.

Suggested use: Roti, paratha, puri, thepla, chapati.

Title: Organic White Quinoa
Body (HTML):
Quinoa has found a warm home in health-conscious Indian kitchens. Dalify sources certified organic white quinoa for its mild flavor and fluffy texture when cooked. Complete protein (all 9 essential amino acids), gluten-free, and quick-cooking (15 minutes).

Use it as a rice substitute in pulao, add to salads, or cook as a morning porridge with dates and coconut.

Suggested use: Pulao, salads, grain bowls, morning porridge, khichdi.

Title: Organic Buckwheat (Kuttu)
Body (HTML):
A Navratri fasting grain with year-round nutritional value. Buckwheat is gluten-free, high in rutin, and has a satisfying, slightly nutty flavor.

Dalify's organic kuttu is sourced from Himachal Pradesh farms. Use the flour for kuttu puris or pancakes; cook the groats like a grain for bowls and porridge.

Suggested use: Kuttu puri, pancakes, grain bowls, porridge.

Title: Organic Poha (Flattened Rice)
Body (HTML):
Dalify's Organic Poha is made from certified organic rice, lightly flattened and dried without any bleaching or chemical processing.

Available in thin and thick varieties. Thin poha dissolves quickly for chivda; thick poha holds shape for the classic breakfast poha with mustard, peas, and potatoes.

Suggested use: Breakfast poha, chivda, sweet rice preparations, quick snacks.

Title: Organic Semolina (Sooji / Rava)
Body (HTML):
Coarse-ground from organic whole wheat, Dalify's semolina is the base for upma, halwa, and idli. Our sooji is stone-ground and retains a slightly more golden color than bleached commercial rava.

Roasting it before use in upma or sheera gives it a beautiful nutty depth.

Suggested use: Upma, rava idli, rava dosa, suji halwa, sheera.

Title: Organic Toor Dal (Split Pigeon Pea)
Body (HTML):
The backbone of Indian dal. Dalify's Organic Toor Dal comes from certified farms in Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh. Our unpolished toor is free from the oil coating that commercial brands use to improve appearance — meaning better nutrition and a richer, earthier flavor.

This is the dal you want for sambar, dal fry, and the simplest, most comforting bowl of dal-chawal.

Suggested use: Dal fry, sambar, dal tadka, khichdi, dal-chawal.

Title: Organic Yellow Moong Dal (Split)
Body (HTML):
Light, easy to digest, and deeply nutritious — yellow moong dal is one of Ayurveda's most valued foods. Dalify's organic split moong is sourced from Rajasthan farms and cooked without the polishing that strips away nutrients.

Ready in under 20 minutes without a pressure cooker. Make moong dal khichdi, moong dal cheela, or simple dal with lemon.

Suggested use: Dal, khichdi, cheela, sprouting, soups.

Title: Organic Whole Green Moong Dal
Body (HTML):
Whole mung beans — the unsung heroes of the pulse world. Used for sprouting, moong stir-fry (moong usal), and dal preparations with the skin on. Higher fiber and iron content than the split yellow variety.

Soak overnight and sprout for a crunchy, living food addition to salads. Dalify's organic whole green moong comes from Rajasthan.

Suggested use: Sprouting, moong usal, whole dal preparations, soups.

Title: Organic Masoor Dal (Red Lentils)
Body (HTML):
The quickest-cooking dal in your pantry — red lentils are ready in 15 minutes without soaking. Dalify's Organic Masoor Dal has a lovely earthy-sweet flavor and turns a golden orange color when cooked. Rich in protein and iron.

Use it as the base for a simple everyday dal, blend it into soups, or add to rice for quick khichdi when time is short.

Suggested use: Quick dal, soups, khichdi, everyday dal-chawal.

Title: Organic Chana Dal (Split Bengal Gram)
Body (HTML):
Chana dal has the richest, most robust flavor of all Indian dals — and it holds its shape even when fully cooked. Dalify's organic chana dal comes from Madhya Pradesh farms.

Essential for chana dal fry, Bengal's chana preparations, and as an ingredient in sambar powder. Also used to make besan flour.

Suggested use: Chana dal fry, sambar, besan making, dal baati, halwa.

Title: Organic Kabuli Chana (Chickpeas)
Body (HTML):
Large, creamy chickpeas perfect for the Punjabi household staple — chole. Dalify sources certified organic kabuli chana from Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. Soak overnight and pressure cook for a soft but intact bean that absorbs masala beautifully.

Also perfect for hummus, Mediterranean-style salads, and roasted crunchy chickpea snacks.

Suggested use: Chole, hummus, salads, roasted snacks, falafel.

Title: Organic Kala Chana (Black Chickpeas)
Body (HTML):
The desi chickpea — smaller, darker, and more nutritionally dense than kabuli chana. Higher in fiber, protein, and iron, with a firmer, nuttier bite.

A quintessential ingredient for the 'prasad' of North Indian temples and just as delicious as a spiced dry sabzi or in tamarind-based chaat. Dalify's organic kala chana comes from Rajasthan.

Suggested use: Kala chana curry, navratri prasad, chaat, dry sabzi.

Title: Organic Rajma — Dark Red (Jammu)
Body (HTML):
No Sunday meal plan is complete without rajma-chawal. Dalify's Organic Dark Red Rajma comes from the Jammu variety — smaller and darker than large kidney beans, with a creamier texture and more complex flavor.

Soak overnight, pressure cook until very soft, then simmer in a rich onion-tomato-spice base until the gravy turns thick and silky.

Suggested use: Rajma chawal, bean soups, burritos, salads.

Title: Organic Rajma Chitra (Speckled Kidney Beans)
Body (HTML):
The speckled Chitra variety of rajma is beloved in Himachal Pradesh for its thinner skin and quicker cook time. Slightly lighter in flavor than dark red rajma, but equally satisfying.

Dalify sources organic chitra rajma directly from hill farms in Himachal. Great for those who want a slightly lighter rajma preparation.

Suggested use: Rajma chawal, soups, mixed bean dishes.

Title: Organic Whole Urad Dal (Black)
Body (HTML):
The star of the tandoor — whole urad (black gram with skin) is what gives Dal Makhani its legendary, silky richness. When slow-cooked for hours with organic butter and cream, the urad breaks down into a velvet sauce that's impossible to replicate with any other pulse.

Also essential for making idli and dosa batter. Dalify's organic whole urad comes from Madhya Pradesh.

Suggested use: Dal makhani, idli-dosa batter, black dal.

Title: Organic White Urad Dal (Split)
Body (HTML):
The skinless, split form of urad dal — used in South Indian cooking with abandon. Dalify's organic white urad is crucial for idli and dosa batters, medu vada, and as a toasting spice in South Indian tadkas.

Also used in papad making and as the base of vada batter. Ferments beautifully to give the characteristic tang to idli.

Suggested use: Idli, dosa, medu vada, tadka, papad.

Title: Organic Moth Beans (Matki)
Body (HTML):
A tiny, nutrient-dense legume used in Maharashtra's famous Misal Pav and Usal. Moth beans are quick to sprout (24-36 hours) and delicious when pressure cooked with a spicy coconut gravy.

High in protein and iron. Dalify sources certified organic matki from Rajasthan dryland farms.

Suggested use: Misal pav, usal, sprouting, stir-fries.

Title: Organic Lobia (Black-Eyed Peas)
Body (HTML):
Lobia curry is a popular Punjabi winter dish — earthy, slightly sweet, and enormously satisfying. Black-eyed peas are also a powerhouse of folate and fiber.

Dalify's organic lobia comes from Rajasthan. Soak for 4 hours and pressure cook until tender but not mushy, then prepare with a thick, spiced tomato gravy.

Suggested use: Lobia curry, salads, rice dishes, soups.

Title: Organic Dosa Mix
Body (HTML):
Crispy, golden, perfectly tangy dosa at home in under 20 minutes — without the 12-hour fermentation process. Dalify's Organic Dosa Mix uses a carefully calibrated blend of organic rice flour, urad dal flour, and organic sooji.

No artificial leavening agents, no added colors. Just add water, mix, rest for 30 minutes, and pour onto a hot tawa.

Suggested use: Plain dosa, masala dosa, onion dosa, set dosa.

Title: Organic Idli Mix
Body (HTML):
Soft, fluffy, perfectly pillowy idlis — every single time. Our Organic Idli Mix uses a blend of organic parboiled rice flour and organic white urad dal flour with added organic flattened rice for natural lightness.

No synthetic raising agents. Mix with water, rest for 30 minutes, steam for 12 minutes. Done.

Suggested use: Plain idli, button idli, mini idlis, idli fry.

Title: Organic Upma Mix
Body (HTML):
Upma that's ready in 10 minutes and tastes like it came from a South Indian breakfast house. Dalify's Organic Upma Mix uses coarse organic semolina, pre-blended with dried curry leaves, mustard seeds, and dried ginger — all the tadka flavors you'd normally add separately.

Just temper, add water, stir, and it's done.

Suggested use: Plain upma, vegetable upma, rava pongal.

Title: Organic Poha Mix
Body (HTML):
The beloved Mumbai breakfast made effortless. Our Poha Mix combines organic thick poha with pre-measured spice blends of turmeric, mustard seeds, and coriander.

Rinse the poha, sauté with the spice mix, and breakfast is served. Add peanuts and coriander for a complete experience. Light, energizing, and absolutely delicious.

Suggested use: Classic breakfast poha, kanda poha, aloo poha.

Title: Organic Dhokla Mix
Body (HTML):
Spongy, tangy, and irresistibly snackable. Dalify's Organic Dhokla Mix is based on the classic Gujarati recipe using organic chana dal flour and rice flour. The mix is precisely balanced so you get that perfect spongy texture and slightly sour flavor without any guesswork.

Just add water, curd, and fruit salt. Steam for 15 minutes.

Suggested use: Classic dhokla, sandwich dhokla, party snacks.

Title: Organic Khaman Mix
Body (HTML):
Similar to dhokla but made with chickpea flour alone for a denser, spongier result. Our Khaman Mix produces the authentic Gujarati style with a glossy, sugary-tangy tempering.

All organic ingredients, no artificial yellow color — our khaman is naturally cream-colored from chickpea flour.

Suggested use: Khaman, party snack, tiffin box.

Title: Organic Besan (Chickpea Flour)
Body (HTML):
Stone-ground from organic chana dal, Dalify's besan is finer-textured and more flavorful than factory-milled commercial besan. The difference is immediately apparent in kadhi, pakoras, and besan chilla.

No anti-caking agents, no added colors. Available in fine (for kadhi, cheela, ladoo) and coarse (for bhajiya and fritters) grinds.

Suggested use: Kadhi, pakoras, besan cheela, missi roti, besan laddoo.

Title: Organic Multigrain Atta
Body (HTML):
Our proprietary multigrain atta combines organic whole wheat with organic ragi, jowar, bajra, and soya flour in a balanced ratio. The result is a flour that makes rotis with more nutritional density, a slightly darker color, and a nuttier taste profile than plain wheat atta.

No dough conditioners or bleaching agents.

Suggested use: Roti, paratha, thepla, chapati, puri.

Title: Organic Sattu (Roasted Gram Flour)
Body (HTML):
Bihar and Uttar Pradesh's protein powerhouse. Sattu is roasted chana ground into a flour — no further cooking needed, making it perfect for quick nutrition on the go.

Mix with water, lemon, and spices for the refreshing sattu drink popular in summer, or make sattu parathas stuffed with a spiced sattu filling.

Suggested use: Sattu sharbat, sattu paratha stuffing, litti chokha.

Title: Organic Khichdi Mix
Body (HTML):
A complete one-pot meal in a bag. Dalify's Organic Khichdi Mix combines premium basmati rice with moong dal in the ideal 1:1 ratio, pre-spiced with turmeric, cumin, and bay leaf.

Add water, a spoon of ghee, and pressure cook for 3 whistles. The most comforting, nourishing, and effortless meal in your kitchen.

Suggested use: Simple khichdi, one-pot comfort meal, healing food.

Title: Organic Pongal Mix
Body (HTML):
A South Indian breakfast classic — rice and moong dal simmered together into a creamy, slightly porridge-like consistency. Dalify's Pongal Mix has the perfect ratio of organic short-grain rice and organic moong dal, with pre-measured spice inclusions.

Makes ven pongal in under 20 minutes from scratch.

Suggested use: Ven pongal, chakkarai pongal, breakfast, festival food.

Title: Organic Rava Ladoo Mix
Body (HTML):
The simplest Indian sweet just got even simpler. Dalify's Rava Ladoo Mix pre-combines organic sooji, organic desiccated coconut, and organic cane sugar. Just roast the mix lightly in ghee until fragrant, add cardamom, shape into balls while still warm.

Perfect for festivals, gifting, and satisfying sweet cravings without additives.

Suggested use: Rava laddoo, festival sweets, gifting.

Title: Organic Millet Dosa Mix
Body (HTML):
A healthier evolution of the classic dosa mix. Dalify's Millet Dosa Mix replaces a significant portion of rice flour with a blend of organic foxtail millet and organic finger millet flours, lowering the glycemic index while maintaining the characteristic crisp texture of a good dosa.

Excellent for diabetic-friendly cooking and anyone seeking to incorporate ancient grains effortlessly.

Suggested use: Millet dosa, millet crepes, savory pancakes.

Title: Organic Jaggery Powder (Gur Powder)
Body (HTML):
Unrefined, chemical-free jaggery — the natural sweetener of Indian tradition. Dalify sources organic jaggery powder from Kolhapur, Maharashtra, where traditional sugarcane processing methods are still used.

Zero added chemicals, zero sulfur. Slightly richer and more complex flavor than refined sugar. Rich in iron, calcium, and potassium.

Suggested use: Chai sweetener, dal, laddoos, kheer, imli chutney, daily consumption.

Title: Organic Tamarind Block (Imli)
Body (HTML):
Deep, naturally tart tamarind sourced from organic orchards in Tamil Nadu. Dalify's tamarind block is seedless and made without sulfur dioxide — a common preservative in commercial tamarind.

Dissolve in warm water, strain, and use in sambar, rasam, and classic imli chutney for chaat.

Suggested use: Sambar, rasam, tamarind rice, imli chutney.

Title: Organic Coconut Milk Powder
Body (HTML):
Sun-dried and spray-processed from certified organic coconuts in Kerala. Reconstitutes easily in warm water to a creamy, rich coconut milk for Kerala curries, payasam, and coconut rice.

No hydrogenated fat, no preservatives. Longer shelf life than canned coconut milk and more convenient for everyday use.

Suggested use: Kerala curries, payasam, coconut rice, Thai-inspired dishes.

Title: Organic Dry Fruits Mix (Trail Mix)
Body (HTML):
A premium blend of organic cashews, organic almonds, organic raisins, and organic dried figs — all sourced from certified organic farms. No added sugar, no sulfur dioxide preservatives, no industrial oils.

Packed in nitrogen-flushed pouches to preserve freshness. The kind of clean snacking you can feel good about.

Suggested use: Snacking, dessert garnish, laddoo preparation, travel food.
